name: Theia Insights
description:
Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into Claude. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores.

The data is built on the Theia Insights Industry Classification (TIIC): a five-level, one-to-many taxonomy mapping companies to 3,000+ investable themes based on what they actually do. Performance is tracked through Theme Watch Indices (TWI), with 10+ years of daily history across global regions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Theia Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Theia Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.theiainsights.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Theia Insights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Theia Insights lists 14 MCP tools, including get_tiic_taxonomy, get_tiic_item, get_tiic_item_exposed_companies, get_twi_indices, get_twi_time_periods, get_twi_regions, get_twi_index_values, get_twi_rankings, get_twi_rankings_chart, lookup_company, get_company, and get_company_tiic_exposures.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Theia Insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Theia Insights in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Theia Insights MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Theia Insights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Theia Insights is developed by Theia Insights, Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
